facts.text: Audrey believes that positive reinforcement is the proper way for pets to learn behavior.

evidence.quote: I just think its important to have pets learn how to behave on a positive reinforcement way. Punishment is never the proper way for pets ya know?

facts.text: Andrew is considering attending a workshop on dog training.

evidence.quote: I'm excited to hear about it. Have a great time at the workshop!
You think so? Wow, you must be a good salesperson because I'm almost sold on this class haha.

facts.text: Audrey plans to keep Andrew updated on the progress of her dogs and share training tips.

evidence.quote: I'll keep you updated on how it all goes and how my pups are doing. Fingers crossed they'll be extra behaved. And I'll let you know some tips on training your future dog as well!
